ο.def: the definite article; the (sometimes to be supplied, at others omitted, in English idiom). KJV: the, this, that, one, he, she, it, etc.

ογδοηκοντα.def: from ὄγδοος (G3590); ten times eight. KJV: fourscore.

ογδοοσ.def: from ὀκτώ (G3638); the eighth. KJV: eighth.

ογκοσ.def: probably from the same as ἀγκάλη (G43); a mass (as bending or bulging by its load), i.e. burden (hindrance). KJV: weight.

οδε.def: from ὁ (G3588) and δέ (G1161); the same, i.e. this or that one (plural these or those); often used as a personal pronoun. KJV: he, she, such, these, thus.

οδευω.def: from ὁδός (G3598); to travel. KJV: journey.

οδηγεω.def: from ὁδηγός (G3595); to show the way (literally or figuratively (teach)). KJV: guide, lead.

οδηγοσ.def: from ὁδός (G3598) and ἡγέομαι (G2233); a conductor (literally or figuratively (teacher)). KJV: guide, leader.

οδοιπορεω.def: from a compound of ὁδός (G3598) and πορεύομαι (G4198); to be a wayfarer, i.e. travel. KJV: go on a journey.

οδοιπορια.def: from the same as ὁδοιπορέω (G3596); travel. KJV: journey(-ing).

οδοσ.def: apparently a primary word; a road; by implication, a progress (the route, act or distance); figuratively, a mode or means. KJV: journey, (high-)way.

οδουσ.def: perhaps from the base of ἐσθίω (G2068); a "tooth". KJV: tooth.

οδυναω.def: from ὀδύνη (G3601); to grieve. KJV: sorrow, torment.

οδυνη.def: from δύνω (G1416); grief (as dejecting). KJV: sorrow.

οδυρμοσ.def: from a derivative of the base of δύνω (G1416); moaning, i.e. lamentation. KJV: mourning.

οεστι.def: from the neuter of ὅς (G3739) and the third person singular present indicative of εἰμί (G1510); which is. KJV: called, which is (make), that is (to say).

οζιασ.def: of Hebrew origin (H5818); Ozias (i.e. Uzzijah), an Israelite. KJV: Ozias.

οζω.def: a primary verb (in a strengthened form); to scent (usually an ill "odor"). KJV: stink.

οθεν.def: from ὅς (G3739) with the directive enclitic of source; from which place or source or cause (adverb or conjunction). KJV: from thence, (from) whence, where(-by, -fore, -upon).

οθονη.def: of uncertain affinity; a linen cloth, i.e. (especially) a sail. KJV: sheet.

οθονιον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of ὀθόνη (G3607); a linen bandage. KJV: linen clothes.

οικειοσ.def: from οἶκος (G3624); domestic, i.e. (as noun), a relative, adherent. KJV: (those) of the (his own) house(-hold).

οικετησ.def: from οἰκέω (G3611); a fellow resident, i.e. menial domestic. KJV: (household) servant.

οικεω.def: from οἶκος (G3624); to occupy a house, i.e. reside (figuratively, inhabit, remain, inhere); by implication, to cohabit. KJV: dwell.

οικημα.def: from οἰκέω (G3611); a tenement, i.e. (specially), a jail. KJV: prison.

οικητηριον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of οἰκέω (G3611) (equivalent to οἴκημα (G3612)); a residence (literally or figuratively). KJV: habitation, house.

οικια.def: from οἶκος (G3624); properly, residence (abstractly), but usually (concretely) an abode (literally or figuratively); by implication, a family (especially domestics). KJV: home, house(-hold).

οικιακοσ.def: from οἰκία (G3614); familiar, i.e. (as noun) relatives. KJV: they (them) of (his own) household.

οικοδεσποτεω.def: from οἰκοδεσπότης (G3617); to be the head of (i.e. rule) a family. KJV: guide the house.

οικοδεσποτησ.def: from οἶκος (G3624) and δεσπότης (G1203); the head of a family. KJV: goodman (of the house), householder, master of the house.

οικοδομεω.def: from the same as οἰκοδομή (G3619); to be a house-builder, i.e. construct or (figuratively) confirm. KJV: (be in) build(-er, -ing, up), edify, embolden.

οικοδομη.def: feminine (abstract) of a compound of οἶκος (G3624) and the base of δῶμα (G1430); architecture, i.e. (concretely) a structure; figuratively, confirmation. KJV: building, edify(-ication, -ing).

οικοδομια.def: from the same as οἰκοδομή (G3619); confirmation. KJV: edifying.

οικονομεω.def: from οἰκονόμος (G3623); to manage (a house, i.e. an estate). KJV: be steward.

οικονομια.def: from οἰκονόμος (G3623); administration (of a household or estate); specially, a (religious) "economy". KJV: dispensation, stewardship.

οικονομοσ.def: from οἶκος (G3624) and the base of νόμος (G3551); a house-distributor (i.e. manager), or overseer, i.e. an employee in that capacity; by extension, a fiscal agent (treasurer); figuratively, a preacher (of the Gospel). KJV: chamberlain, governor, steward.

οικοσ.def: of uncertain affinity; a dwelling (more or less extensive, literal or figurative); by implication, a family (more or less related, literally or figuratively). KJV: home, house(-hold), temple.

οικουμενη.def: feminine participle present passive of οἰκέω (G3611) (as noun, by implication, of γῆ (G1093)); land, i.e. the (terrene part of the) globe; specially, the Roman empire. KJV: earth, world.

οικουροσ.def: from οἶκος (G3624) and οὖρος (a guard; be "ware"); a stayer at home, i.e. domestically inclined (a "good housekeeper"). KJV: keeper at home.

οικτειρω.def: from οἶκτος (pity); to exercise pity. KJV: have compassion on.

οικτιρμων.def: from οἰκτείρω (G3627); compassionate. KJV: merciful, of tender mercy.

οινοποτησ.def: from οἶνος (G3631) and a derivative of the alternate of πίνω (G4095); a tippler. KJV: winebibber.

οινοσ.def: a primary word (or perhaps of Hebrew origin (H3196)); "wine" (literally or figuratively). KJV: wine.

οινοφλυγια.def: from οἶνος (G3631) and a form of the base of φλύαρος (G5397); an overflow (or surplus) of wine, i.e. vinolency (drunkenness). KJV: excess of wine.

οιομαι.def: middle voice apparently from οἷος (G3634); to make like (oneself), i.e. imagine (be of the opinion). KJV: suppose, think.

οιοσ.def: probably akin to ὁ (G3588), ὅς (G3739), and ὅσος (G3745); such or what sort of (as a correlation or exclamation); especially the neuter (adverbially) with negative, not so. KJV: so (as), such as, what (manner of), which.

οκνεω.def: from ὄκνος (hesitation); to be slow (figuratively, loath). KJV: delay.

οκνηροσ.def: from ὀκνέω (G3635); tardy, i.e. indolent; (figuratively) irksome. KJV: grievous, slothful.

οκταημεροσ.def: from ὀκτώ (G3638) and ἡμέρα (G2250); an eight-day old person or act. KJV: the eighth day.

ολεθροσ.def: from a primary ὄλλυμι (to destroy; a prolonged form); ruin, i.e. death, punishment. KJV: destruction.

ολιγοπιστοσ.def: from ὀλίγος (G3641) and πίστις (G4102); incredulous, i.e. lacking confidence (in Christ). KJV: of little faith.

ολιγοσ.def: of uncertain affinity; puny (in extent, degree, number, duration or value); especially neuter (adverbially) somewhat. KJV: + almost, brief(-ly), few, (a) little, + long, a season, short, small, a while.

ολιγοψυχοσ.def: from ὀλίγος (G3641) and (G6590); little-spirited, i.e. faint-hearted. KJV: feebleminded.

ολιγωρεω.def: from a compound of ὀλίγος (G3641) and ὤρα ("care"); to have little regard for, i.e. to disesteem. KJV: despise.

ολοθρευτησ.def: from ὀλοθρεύω (G3645); a ruiner, i.e. (specially), a venomous serpent. KJV: destroyer.

ολοθρευω.def: from ὄλεθρος (G3639); to spoil, i.e. slay. KJV: destroy.

ολοκαυτωμα.def: from a derivative of a compound of ὅλος (G3650) and a derivative of καίω (G2545); a wholly-consumed sacrifice ("holocaust"). KJV: (whole) burnt offering.

ολοκληρια.def: from ὁλόκληρος (G3648); integrity, i.e. physical wholeness. KJV: perfect soundness.

ολοκληροσ.def: from ὅλος (G3650) and κλῆρος (G2819); complete in every part, i.e. perfectly sound (in body). KJV: entire, whole.

ολολυζω.def: a reduplicated primary verb; to "howl" or "halloo", i.e. shriek. KJV: howl.

ολοσ.def: a primary word; "whole" or "all", i.e. complete (in extent, amount, time or degree), especially (neuter) as noun or adverb. KJV: all, altogether, every whit, + throughout, whole.

ολοτελησ.def: from ὅλος (G3650) and τέλος (G5056); complete to the end, i.e. absolutely perfect. KJV: wholly.

ολυμπασ.def: probably a contraction from Ὀλυμπιόδωρος (Olympian-bestowed, i.e. heaven-descended); Olympas, a Christian. KJV: Olympas.

ολυνθοσ.def: of uncertain derivation; an unripe (because out of season) fig. KJV: untimely fig.

ολωσ.def: adverb from ὅλος (G3650); completely, i.e. altogether; (by analogy), everywhere; (negatively) not by any means. KJV: at all, commonly, utterly.

ομβροσ.def: of uncertain affinity; a thunder storm. KJV: shower.

ομιλεω.def: from ὅμιλος (G3658); to be in company with, i.e. (by implication) to converse. KJV: commune, talk.

ομιλια.def: from ὅμιλος (G3658); companionship ("homily"), i.e. (by implication) intercourse. KJV: communication.

ομιλοσ.def: from the base of ὁμοῦ (G3674) and a derivative of the alternate of αἱρέομαι (G138) (meaning a crowd); association together, i.e. a multitude. KJV: company.

ομμα.def: from ὀπτάνομαι (G3700); a sight, i.e. (by implication) the eye. KJV: eye.

ομνυω.def: a prolonged form of a primary, but obsolete ὄμω, for which another prolonged form ὀμόω is used in certain tenses; to swear, i.e. take (or declare on) oath. KJV: swear.

ομοθυμαδον.def: adverb from a compound of the base of ὁμοῦ (G3674) and θυμός (G2372); unanimously. KJV: with one accord (mind).

ομοιαζω.def: from ὅμοιος (G3664); to resemble. KJV: agree.

ομοιοπαθησ.def: from ὅμοιος (G3664) and the alternate of πάσχω (G3958); similarly affected. KJV: of (subject to) like passions.

ομοιοσ.def: from the base of ὁμοῦ (G3674); similar (in appearance or character). KJV: like, + manner.

ομοιοτησ.def: from ὅμοιος (G3664); resemblance. KJV: like as, similitude.

ομοιοω.def: from ὅμοιος (G3664); to assimilate, i.e. compare; passively, to become similar. KJV: be (make) like, (in the) liken(-ess), resemble.

ομοιωμα.def: from ὁμοιόω (G3666); a form; abstractly, resemblance. KJV: made like to, likeness, shape, similitude.

ομοιωσ.def: adverb from ὅμοιος (G3664); similarly. KJV: likewise, so.

ομοιωσισ.def: from ὁμοιόω (G3666); assimilation, i.e. resemblance. KJV: similitude.

ομολογεω.def: from a compound of the base of ὁμοῦ (G3674) and λόγος (G3056); to assent, i.e. covenant, acknowledge. KJV: con- (pro-)fess, confession is made, give thanks, promise.

ομολογια.def: from the same as ὁμολογέω (G3670); acknowledgment. KJV: con- (pro-)fession, professed.

ομολογουμενωσ.def: adverb of present passive participle of ὁμολογέω (G3670); confessedly. KJV: without controversy.

ομοτεχνοσ.def: from the base of ὁμοῦ (G3674) and τέχνη (G5078); a fellow-artificer. KJV: of the same craft.

ομου.def: genitive case of ὁμός (the same; akin to ἅμα (G260)) as adverb; at the same place or time. KJV: together.

ομοφρων.def: from the base of ὁμοῦ (G3674) and φρήν (G5424); like-minded, i.e. harmonious. KJV: of one mind.

ομωσ.def: adverb from the base of ὁμοῦ (G3674); at the same time, i.e. (conjunctionally) notwithstanding, yet still. KJV: and even, nevertheless, though but.

οναρ.def: of uncertain derivation; a dream. KJV: dream.

οναριον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of ὄνος (G3688); a little ass. KJV: young ass.

ονειδιζω.def: from ὄνειδος (G3681); to defame, i.e. rail at, chide, taunt. KJV: cast in teeth, (suffer) reproach, revile, upbraid.

ονειδοσ.def: probably akin to the base of ὄνομα (G3686); notoriety, i.e. a taunt (disgrace). KJV: reproach.

ονησιμοσ.def: from ὀνίνημι (G3685); profitable; Onesimus, a Christian. KJV: Onesimus.

ονησιφοροσ.def: from a derivative of ὀνίνημι (G3685) and φόρος (G5411); profit-bearer; Onesiphorus, a Christian. KJV: Onespiphorus.

ονικοσ.def: from ὄνος (G3688); belonging to a ass, i.e. large (so as to be turned by a ass). KJV: millstone.

ονινημι.def: a prolonged form of an apparently primary verb (ὄνομαι, to slur); for which another prolonged form (ὀνάω) is used as an alternate in some tenses (unless indeed it be identical with the base of ὄνομα (G3686) through the idea of notoriety); to gratify, i.e. (middle voice) to derive pleasure or advantage from. KJV: have joy.

ονομα.def: from a presumed derivative of the base of γινώσκω (G1097) (compare ὀνίνημι (G3685)); a "name" (literally or figuratively) (authority, character). KJV: called, (+ sur-)name(-d).

ονομαζω.def: from ὄνομα (G3686); to name, i.e. assign an appellation; by extension, to utter, mention, profess. KJV: call, name.

ονοσ.def: apparently a primary word; a donkey. KJV: an ass.

οντωσ.def: adverb of the oblique cases of ὤν (G5607); really. KJV: certainly, clean, indeed, of a truth, verily.

οξοσ.def: from ὀξύς (G3691); vinegar, i.e. sour wine. KJV: vinegar.

οξυσ.def: probably akin to the base of ἀκμήν (G188) ("acid"); keen; by analogy, rapid. KJV: sharp, swift.

οπη.def: probably from ὀπτάνομαι (G3700); a hole (as if for light), i.e. cavern; by analogy, a spring (of water). KJV: cave, place.

οπισθεν.def: from ὄπις (regard; from ὀπτάνομαι (G3700)) with enclitic of source; from the rear (as a secure aspect), i.e. at the back (adverb and preposition of place or time). KJV: after, backside, behind.

οπισω.def: from the same as ὄπισθεν (G3693) with enclitic of direction; to the back, i.e. aback (as adverb or preposition of time or place; or as noun). KJV: after, back(-ward), (+ get) behind, + follow.

οπλιζω.def: from ὅπλον (G3696); to equip (with weapons (middle voice and figuratively)). KJV: arm self.

οπλον.def: probably from a primary ἕπω (to be busy about); an implement or utensil or tool (literally or figuratively, especially, offensive for war). KJV: armour, instrument, weapon.

οποιοσ.def: from ὅς (G3739) and ποῖος (G4169); of what kind that, i.e. how (as) great (excellent) (specially, as an indefinite correlative to the definite antecedent τοιοῦτος (G5108) of quality). KJV: what manner (sort) of, such as whatsoever.

οποτε.def: from ὅς (G3739) and ποτέ (G4218); what(-ever) then, i.e. (of time) as soon as. KJV: when.

οπου.def: from ὅς (G3739) and πού (G4225); what(-ever) where, i.e. at whichever spot. KJV: in what place, where(-as, -soever), whither (+ soever).

οπτανομαι.def: a (middle voice) prolonged form of the primary (middle voice) ὄπτομαι; which is used for it in certain tenses; and both as alternate of ὁράω (G3708); to gaze (i.e. with wide-open eyes, as at something remarkable; and thus differing from βλέπω (G991), which denotes simply voluntary observation; and from εἴδω (G1492), which expresses merely mechanical, passive or casual vision; while θεάομαι (G2300), and still more emphatically its intensive θεωρέω (G2334), signifies an earnest but more continued inspection; and σκοπέω (G4648) a watching from a distance). KJV: appear, look, see, shew self.

οπτασια.def: from a presumed derivative of ὀπτάνομαι (G3700); visuality, i.e. (concretely) an apparition. KJV: vision.

οπτοσ.def: from an obsolete verb akin to ἕπσω (to "steep"); cooked, i.e. roasted. KJV: broiled.

οπωρα.def: apparently from the base of ὀψέ (G3796) and ὥρα (G5610); properly, even-tide of the (summer) season (dog-days), i.e. (by implication) ripe fruit. KJV: fruit.

οπωσ.def: from ὅς (G3739) and πῶς (G4459); what(-ever) how, i.e. in the manner that (as adverb or conjunction of coincidence, intentional or actual). KJV: because, how, (so) that, to, when.

οραμα.def: from ὁράω (G3708); something gazed at, i.e. a spectacle (especially supernatural). KJV: sight, vision.

ορασισ.def: from ὁράω (G3708); the act of gazing, i.e. (externally) an aspect or (internally) an inspired appearance. KJV: sight, vision.

ορατοσ.def: from ὁράω (G3708); gazed at, i.e. (by implication) capable of being seen. KJV: visible.

οραω.def: properly, to stare at (compare ὀπτάνομαι (G3700)), i.e. (by implication) to discern clearly (physically or mentally); by extension, to attend to; by Hebraism, to experience; passively, to appear. KJV: behold, perceive, see, take heed.

οργη.def: from ὀρέγομαι (G3713); properly, desire (as a reaching forth or excitement of the mind), i.e. (by analogy), violent passion (ire, or (justifiable) abhorrence); by implication punishment. KJV: anger, indignation, vengeance, wrath.

οργιζω.def: from ὀργή (G3709); to provoke or enrage, i.e. (passively) become exasperated. KJV: be angry (wroth).

οργιλοσ.def: from ὀργή (G3709); irascible. KJV: soon angry.

οργυια.def: from ὀρέγομαι (G3713); a stretch of the arms, i.e. a fathom. KJV: fathom.

ορεγομαι.def: middle voice of apparently a prolonged form of an obsolete primary (compare ὄρος (G3735)); to stretch oneself, i.e. reach out after (long for). KJV: covet after, desire.

ορεινοσ.def: from ὄρος (G3735); mountainous, i.e. (feminine by implication, of χώρα (G5561)) the Highlands (of Judæa). KJV: hill country.

ορεξισ.def: from ὀρέγομαι (G3713); excitement of the mind, i.e. longing after. KJV: lust.

ορθοποδεω.def: from a compound of ὀρθός (G3717) and πούς (G4228); to be straight-footed, i.e. (figuratively) to go directly forward. KJV: walk uprightly.

ορθοσ.def: probably from the base of ὄρος (G3735); right (as rising), i.e. (perpendicularly) erect (figuratively, honest), or (horizontally) level or direct. KJV: straight, upright.

ορθοτομεω.def: from a compound of ὀρθός (G3717) and the base of τομώτερος (G5114), to make a straight cut, i.e. (figuratively) to dissect (expound) correctly (the divine message). KJV: rightly divide.

ορθριζω.def: from ὄρθρος (G3722); to use the dawn, i.e. (by implication) to repair betimes. KJV: come early in the morning.

ορθρινοσ.def: from ὄρθρος (G3722); relating to the dawn, i.e. matutinal (as an epithet of Venus, especially brilliant in the early day). KJV: morning.

ορθριοσ.def: from ὄρθρος (G3722); in the dawn, i.e. up at day-break. KJV: early.

ορθροσ.def: from the same as ὄρος (G3735); dawn (as sun-rise, rising of light); by extension, morn. KJV: early in the morning.

ορθωσ.def: adverb from ὀρθός (G3717); in a straight manner, i.e. (figuratively) correctly (also morally). KJV: plain, right(-ly).

οριζω.def: from ὅριον (G3725); to mark out or bound ("horizon"), i.e. (figuratively) to appoint, decree, specify. KJV: declare, determine, limit, ordain.

οριον.def: neuter of a derivative of an apparently primary ὅρος (a bound or limit); a boundary-line, i.e. (by implication) a frontier (region). KJV: border, coast.

ορκιζω.def: from ὅρκος (G3727); to put on oath, i.e. make swear; by analogy, to solemnly enjoin. KJV: adjure, charge.

ορκοσ.def: from ἕρκος (a fence; perhaps akin to ὅριον (G3725)); a limit, i.e. (sacred) restraint (specially, an oath). KJV: oath.

ορκωμοσια.def: from a compound of ὅρκος (G3727) and a derivative of ὀμνύω (G3660); asseveration on oath. KJV: oath.

ορμαω.def: from ὁρμή (G3730); to start, spur or urge on, i.e. (reflexively) to dash or plunge. KJV: run (violently), rush.

ορμη.def: of uncertain affinity; a violent impulse, i.e. onset. KJV: assault.

ορμημα.def: from ὁρμή (G3730); an attack, i.e. (abstractly) precipitancy. KJV: violence.

ορνεον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of ὄρνις (G3733); a birdling. KJV: bird, fowl.

ορνισ.def: probably from a prolonged form of the base of ὄρος (G3735); a bird (as rising in the air), i.e. (specially), a hen (or female domestic fowl). KJV: hen.

οροθεσια.def: from a compound of the base of ὅριον (G3725) and a derivative of τίθημι (G5087); a limit-placing, i.e. (concretely) boundary-line. KJV: bound.

οροσ.def: probably from an obsolete ὄρω (to rise or "rear"; perhaps akin to αἴρω (G142); compare ὄρνις (G3733)); a mountain (as lifting itself above the plain). KJV: hill, mount(-ain).

ορυσσω.def: apparently a primary verb; to "burrow" in the ground, i.e. dig. KJV: dig.

ορφανοσ.def: of uncertain affinity; bereaved ("orphan"), i.e. parentless. KJV: comfortless, fatherless.

ορχεομαι.def: middle voice from ὄρχος (a row or ring); to dance (from the ranklike or regular motion). KJV: dance.

οσ.def: probably a primary word (or perhaps a form of the article ὁ (G3588)); the relatively (sometimes demonstrative) pronoun, who, which, what, that. KJV: one, (an-, the) other, some, that, what, which, who(-m, -se), etc.

οσακισ.def: multiple adverb from ὅς (G3739); how (i.e. with ἄν (G302), so) many times as. KJV: as oft(-en) as.

οσιοσ.def: of uncertain affinity; properly, right (by intrinsic or divine character; thus distinguished from 1342, which refers rather to human statutes and relations; from ἱερός (G2413), which denotes formal consecration; and from ἅγιος (G40), which relates to purity from defilement), i.e. hallowed (pious, sacred, sure). KJV: holy, mercy, shalt be.

οσιωσ.def: adverb from ὅσιος (G3741); piously. KJV: holily.

οσμη.def: from ὄζω (G3605); fragrance (literally or figuratively). KJV: odour, savour.

οσοσ.def: by reduplication from ὅς (G3739); as (much, great, long, etc.) as. KJV: all (that), as (long, many, much) (as), how great (many, much), (in-)asmuch as, so many as, that (ever), the more, those things, what (great, -soever), wheresoever, wherewithsoever, which, X while, who(-soever).

οσπερ.def: from ὅς (G3739) and περ (G4007); who especially. KJV: whomsoever.

οστεον.def: of uncertain affinity; a bone. KJV: bone.

οστισ.def: from ὅς (G3739) and τὶς (G5100); which some, i.e. any that; also (definite) which same. KJV: X and (they), (such) as, (they) that, in that they, what(-soever), whereas ye, (they) which, who(-soever).

οστρακινοσ.def: from ὄστρακον ("oyster") (a tile, i.e. terra cotta); earthen-ware, i.e. clayey; by implication, frail. KJV: of earth, earthen.

οσφρησισ.def: from a derivative of ὄζω (G3605); smell (the sense). KJV: smelling.

οσφυσ.def: of uncertain affinity; the loin (externally), i.e. the hip; internally (by extension) procreative power. KJV: loin.

οταν.def: from ὅτε (G3753) and ἄν (G302); whenever (implying hypothesis or more or less uncertainty); also causatively (conjunctionally) inasmuch as. KJV: as long (soon) as, that, + till, when(-soever), while.

οτε.def: from ὅς (G3739) and τέ (G5037); at which (thing) too, i.e. when. KJV: after (that), as soon as, that, when, while.

οτι.def: neuter of ὅστις (G3748) as conjunction; demonstrative, that (sometimes redundant); causative, because. KJV: as concerning that, as though, because (that), for (that), how (that), (in) that, though, why.

οτου.def: for the genitive case of ὅστις (G3748) (as adverb); during which same time, i.e. whilst. KJV: whiles.

ου.def: a primary word; the absolute negative (compare μή (G3361)) adverb; no or not. KJV: + long, nay, neither, never, no (X man), none, (can-)not, + nothing, + special, un(-worthy), when, + without, + yet but.
genitive case of ὅς (G3739) as adverb; at which place, i.e. where. KJV: where(-in), whither(-soever).

ουα.def: a primary exclamation of surprise; "ah". KJV: ah.

ουαι.def: a primary exclamation of grief; "woe". KJV: alas, woe.

ουδαμωσ.def: adverb from (the feminine) of οὐδείς (G3762); by no means. KJV: not.

ουδε.def: from οὐ (G3756) and δέ (G1161); not however, i.e. neither, nor, not even. KJV: neither (indeed), never, no (more, nor, not), nor (yet), (also, even, then) not (even, so much as), + nothing, so much as.

ουδεισ.def: from οὐδέ (G3761) and εἷς (G1520); not even one (man, woman or thing), i.e. none, nobody, nothing. KJV: any (man), aught, man, neither any (thing), never (man), no (man), none (+ of these things), not (any, at all, -thing), nought.

ουδεποτε.def: from οὐδέ (G3761) and ποτέ (G4218); not even at any time, i.e. never at all. KJV: neither at any time, never, nothing at any time.

ουδεπω.def: from οὐδέ (G3761) and -πω (G4452); not even yet. KJV: as yet not, never before (yet), (not) yet.

ουκετι.def: from οὐ (G3756) and ἔτι (G2089); not yet, no longer. KJV: after that (not), (not) any more, henceforth (hereafter) not, no longer (more), not as yet (now), now no more (not), yet (not).

ουκουν.def: from οὐ (G3756) and οὖν (G3767); is it not therefore that, i.e. (affirmatively) hence or so. KJV: then.

ουμη.def: i.e. οὐ (G3756) and μή (G3361); a double negative strengthening the denial; not at all. KJV: any more, at all, by any (no) means, neither, never, no (at all), in no case (wise), nor ever, not (at all, in any wise).

ουν.def: apparently a primary word; (adverbially) certainly, or (conjunctionally) accordingly. KJV: and (so, truly), but, now (then), so (likewise then), then, therefore, verily, wherefore.

ουπω.def: from οὐ (G3756) and -πω (G4452); not yet. KJV: hitherto not, (no…) as yet, not yet.

ουρα.def: apparently a primary word; a tail. KJV: tail.

ουρανιοσ.def: from οὐρανός (G3772); celestial, i.e. belonging to or coming from the sky. KJV: heavenly.

ουρανοθεν.def: from οὐρανός (G3772) and the enclitic of source; from the sky. KJV: from heaven.

ουρανοσ.def: perhaps from the same as ὄρος (G3735) (through the idea of elevation); the sky; by extension, heaven (as the abode of God); by implication, happiness, power, eternity; specially, the Gospel (Christianity). KJV: air, heaven(-ly), sky.

ουρβανοσ.def: of Latin origin; Urbanus (of the city, "urbane"), a Christian. KJV: Urbanus.

ουριασ.def: of Hebrew origin (H223); Urias (i.e. Urijah), a Hittite. KJV: Urias.

ουσ.def: apparently a primary word; the ear (physically or mentally). KJV: ear.

ουσια.def: from the feminine of ὤν (G5607); substance, i.e. property (possessions). KJV: goods, substance.

ουτε.def: from οὐ (G3756) and τέ (G5037); not too, i.e. neither or nor; by analogy, not even. KJV: neither, none, nor (yet), (no, yet) not, nothing.

ουτοσ.def: from the article ὁ (G3588) and αὐτός (G846); the he (she or it), i.e. this or that (often with article repeated). KJV: he (it was that), hereof, it, she, such as, the same, these, they, this (man, same, woman), which, who.

ουτω.def: adverb from οὗτος (G3778); in this way (referring to what precedes or follows). KJV: after that, after (in) this manner, as, even (so), for all that, like(-wise), no more, on this fashion(-wise), so (in like manner), thus, what.

ουχι.def: intensive of οὐ (G3756); not indeed. KJV: nay, not.

οφειλετησ.def: from ὀφείλω (G3784); an ower, i.e. person indebted; figuratively, a delinquent; morally, a transgressor (against God). KJV: debtor, which owed, sinner.

οφειλη.def: from ὀφείλω (G3784); indebtedness, i.e. (concretely) a sum owed; figuratively, obligation, i.e. (conjugal) duty. KJV: debt, due.

οφειλημα.def: from (the alternate of) ὀφείλω (G3784); something owed, i.e. (figuratively) a due; morally, a fault. KJV: debt.

οφειλω.def: probably from the base of ὄφελος (G3786) (through the idea of accruing); to owe (pecuniarily); figuratively, to be under obligation (ought, must, should); morally, to fail in duty. KJV: behove, be bound, (be) debt(-or), (be) due(-ty), be guilty (indebted), (must) need(-s), ought, owe, should.

οφελον.def: first person singular of a past tense of ὀφείλω (G3784); I ought (wish), i.e. (interjection) oh that!. KJV: would (to God).

οφελοσ.def: from ὀφέλλω (to heap up, i.e. accumulate or benefit); gain. KJV: advantageth, profit.

οφθαλμοδουλεια.def: from ὀφθαλμός (G3788) and δουλεία (G1397); sight-labor, i.e. that needs watching (remissness). KJV: eye-service.

οφθαλμοσ.def: from ὀπτάνομαι (G3700); the eye (literally or figuratively); by implication, vision; figuratively, envy (from the jealous side-glance). KJV: eye, sight.

οφισ.def: probably from ὀπτάνομαι (G3700) (through the idea of sharpness of vision); a snake, figuratively, (as a type of sly cunning) an artful malicious person, especially Satan. KJV: serpent.

οφρυσ.def: perhaps from ὀπτάνομαι (G3700) (through the idea of the shading or proximity to the organ of vision); the eye-"brow" or forehead, i.e. (figuratively) the brink of a precipice. KJV: brow.

οχλεω.def: from ὄχλος (G3793); to mob, i.e. (by implication) to harass. KJV: vex.

οχλοποιεω.def: from ὄχλος (G3793) and ποιέω (G4160); to make a crowd, i.e. raise a public disturbance. KJV: gather a company.

οχλοσ.def: from a derivative of ἔχω (G2192) (meaning a vehicle); a throng (as borne along); by implication, the rabble; by extension, a class of people; figuratively, a riot. KJV: company, multitude, number (of people), people, press.

οχυρωμα.def: from a remote derivative of ἔχω (G2192) (meaning to fortify, through the idea of holding safely); a castle (figuratively, argument). KJV: stronghold.

οψαριον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of the base of ὀπτός (G3702); a relish to other food (as if cooked sauce), i.e. (specially), fish (presumably salted and dried as a condiment). KJV: fish.

οψε.def: from the same as ὀπίσω (G3694) (through the idea of backwardness); (adverbially) late in the day; by extension, after the close of the day. KJV: (at) even, in the end.

οψιμοσ.def: from ὀψέ (G3796); later, i.e. vernal (showering). KJV: latter.

οψιοσ.def: from ὀψέ (G3796); late; feminine (as noun) afternoon (early eve) or nightfall (later eve). KJV: even(-ing, (-tide)).

οψισ.def: from ὀπτάνομαι (G3700); properly, sight (the act), i.e. (by implication) the visage, an external show. KJV: appearance, countenance, face.

οψωνιον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of the same as ὀψάριον (G3795); rations for a soldier, i.e. (by extension) his stipend or pay. KJV: wages.

οωνκαιοηνκαιοερχομενοσ.lemma: ὁ ὢν καί ὁ ἦν καί ὁ ἐρχόμενος
οωνκαιοηνκαιοερχομενοσ.def: a phrase combining ὁ (G3588) with the present participle and imperfect of εἰμί (G1510) and the present participle of ἔρχομαι (G2064) by means of καί (G2532); the one being and the one that was and the one coming, i.e. the Eternal, as a divine epithet of Christ. KJV: which art (is, was), and (which) wast (is, was), and art (is) to come (shalt be).
